tei:div.tei:p: "$ (1)༄༅// ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ni gu ma'i chos drug rdo rje'i tshig rkang bzhugs so/// /

shangs pa'i gser chos skor gyi rtsa ba/ (2)༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ dharma ṣaṭa badz+ra gā tha nā ma/ bod skad du/ chos drug rdo rje'i tshig rkang zhes bya ba/ dpal zung 'jug bde ba chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa lo tsā ba'i 'gyur phyag /zhes pa khyad gzhi khyad chos sku gsum bdun ldan te/ gang zhig brjod pa dang bral pa dang lhun gyis grub pa dang 'dus ma byas pa'o/ /kha bde stong snang stong sbyor bde dbang po dang chen dbang po dang longs dbang po dang sku dbang po dang gang 'dul du shar pa sprul sku'i yan lag /sku gsum yan lag bdun dang ldan pa'i rdo rje 'chang chen gyis// theg pa chen po skye ba med pa'i rang sgra 'di skad thos/ pa ste rtogs pa'am mkhyen pa/ dbang smin bar byed pa'i bzhis smin rang byas pa dad pa dang brtson 'grus dang ldan pa/ /mi rtag pa dang skyo shas dang 'khor ba'i 'phar bde drod dang nyes dmigs rnams sngon du rang dag rmi lam nying 'khrul 'gro bas// chos drug gi lam mchog 'di la gang gi khyad chos rnams dang ldan pa sgrub po gang gis 'bad gyur na// zla dbang po rab drug 'bring lo'am tshe tha mas kyang 'dir sangs rgyas su 'gyur ro/ thabs lam rmi lam nying 'khrul rang dag /'od gsal gti mug rang sangs/ 'pho ba ma bsgom sangs rgyas/ (3) /bar do rgyal ba longs sku/ rang gsang dbang gi nyams len lus thabs dang ldan pa la rtsa ro rkyang dbu ma dang gsum 'khor lo ste snying mgrin spyi dang bzhi/ lte 'og gi a shad dang spyi bo'i haṃ yig 'bar zhing 'dzag pa las rnam pa sna tshogs rnam smin rnam nyed mtshan nyid dang bral ba'i/ ma bzhi dang dga' ba mchog dga' khyad dga' lhan skyes te skad cig dga' bzhis brgyan/ pa'o/ /shes dbang gsum pa'i nyams len rab ma'i kha rtsa ga mu kha'i ste mkha' 'gro gdong ma snyoms 'jug gis// yas babs zag bcas mas brtan zag med kyi dga' ba bzhi rim bzhin no// byin rlabs kyi

bcud bsdus pa'i dag byed pa'i nad gdon sel byed stong ra'i gnad sogs gsum dang*// bde drong myur du 'char ba'i thabs gtum mo la sogs pa'i chos drug rim bzhin nyams su blang bar bya te// dang por ri bod dbab de nas gzung de nas ldog de nas dgra ma de nas rlung dang bsre pa'o/ /zag rnam par rtog pa dang bral ba'i med ye shes chen pos rang bzhin yongs su shes pa brgyan par bya ba'i/ lus gnad me'i stong ra/ gtum mo zas su za ba/ gos su gyon pa/ stan du 'ding ba/ srid pa'i dbang zhu ba/ gegs rang grol ba/ rlung rtar zhon pa'o// rang bzhin yongs su shes pa/ (4) sgyu kyi gdams pa snang ba thams cad lus bden med du 'char bar byed pa'i rnal 'byor la/ dbang po rab dang 'bring dang tha ma gsum mo/ /'bral dbang po rab med mos gus 'bring rang lus dang ci snang kun// snang stong zhen pa dang bral ba'i lha sku'i lam khyer bya 'o/ /chags sdang rang grol bcu bzhi'i sa thob 'gyur/ ye shes thig le las/ bum pa'i dbang ni bcu gcig ste// gsang ba'i dbang ni bcu gnyis mchog shes rab ye shes bcu gsum pa/ de ltar de bzhin bcu bzhi pa// dbang re la ni sa re ste/ zhes bshad pa bzhin/ dbang po rang bla ma dam pa grogs su bsten pa// 'bring tshig gzhan gyis bar ma chod par khrid pa/ tha ma mal gcig tu ting nge 'dzin bskyed pa'o// rnal 'byor pa/ gang gis 'jig rten gyis bsam pa thams cad yongs su spangs nas// rmi lam 'dun pa'i gnad la 'bral ba med par bya/ 'o/ des mtshan mo'i/ nying 'khrul rang dag sgyu ma lam rim gyi/ yon tan rnams nyin mtshan gyis dus su zhing thang ngag gis bya'o rang shar du 'byung*/ rmi lam bzung ba/ sbyang ba// spel ba/ sprul pa/ bsgyur ba/ yul snang ngo*/ 'khrul ma zin 'byams/ gnyid yang yang sad ba'i/ sad 'byams/ byang sems nyams pa'i/ 'de 'byams/ stong rmi lam mi ru ye ma 'dod pa'i 'byams rnams so/

/mos byung na bla ma la gus nas/ tshogs tshogs gang che gsog gegs dm-igs pa'i gnad la sogs pa'i sel zhing thang ngag gis bya'o brgyan par bya// 'od gsal 'char bdag par byed pa'i gnad bla ma'i mos gus dang*/ gsol 'debs/ ba bde chen bo'i mi slob pa'i zung 'jug thob pa'i sku zag bcas zag med mas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi'i nyams len dang de dag 'chad pa'i sgyu lus gnad dang lta stangs kyis// bde ba dang*/ gsal ba dang*/ mi rtog pa gsum dbyer med zung 'jug rang shar du 'byung ngo*/ /sbyor bdag par dngos gzhi dang rjes gsum gyis/ dus gnad gyi brgyan par bya/ 'od gsal gzung ba/ lam khyer bsre ba/ mthar thug go gdod ma nas gnas pa'i 'od gsal mngon du gyur pa'i bla ma/ dam pa nyams myong can/ gyis/ slob ma'i 'od gsal gyi/ 'char sgo ngo sprod cing*/ bogs 'don dang*/ gegs sel gyis/ brgyan par bya 'o/ (5) gang du/'pho bar/ bya gang 'pho bar/ byed pa'i dmigs pa bral ba ni dbang po yang rab kyi 'pho ba ste/ dbang po 'bring dang tha mas tshe 'di'i 'khor yug sogs la chags sdang spangs byas nas/ dag pa'i zhing du 'gro snyam pa'i dga' zhing 'pho yul la mos gus dmigs pa rtse gcig gis// gyen du rnam shes 'phang zhing smon lam rgya char btab pas brgyan par bya 'o// chos sku de bzhin nyid kyi 'pho ba/ zung 'jug yi dam gyi 'pho ba/ byin rlabs bla ma'i 'pho ba/ 'chugs med mkha' spyod kyi 'pho ba'o/ /dus nges pa'i 'chi ltas byung ba'i gnad lus gnad skyil krung tsog pu sogs/ ngag gnad bsre 'phor sbyangs pa/ yi ge phyed dang gnyis nga ro drag tu brjod pa yis/ ces pa ltar/ hikra gi sgra dang*/ ldan par byas/ rdzas gnad la/ tsha ba gsum mi klad rnams kyis spyi bor byugs la/ sbyang zhing brtan pa thob pa'i 'pho ba ni mchog yin no/ /rab bar do dang po'i snang mched la/ sogs 'od gsal lha sku 'bring longs spyod rdzogs pa'i

dang*/ tha ma skye sgo dgag ste gang 'dul sprul sku'i gsum ldan du ldang bar byas pa mtshams sbyor chags sdang gi yul la byang sems dkar dmar skyo shas bskyed pa gnad yin no/ /pha ma la chags sdang dang phrag dog rnams 'od gsal lha 'i sprul bsgyur gyi skus sbyangs/ zhing yud tsam bsgoms nas/ shes sgrib dang nyon sgrib gnyis rang dag tu gyur nas sku gsum mngon du 'gyur/ ro/ rab dpa' bo bar do dang po'i gzhi dus kyi 'od gsal rang shar/ 'bring rgyal ba longs/ sku sgyu ma'i lha rang shar/ tha smon lam gyi ma sprul sku 'gags med rang shar/ spyi gnad ni 'chug gsum med lam khyer ro/ gzugs dang sgra dang thugs kyis bstan pa'i dri ro reg bya rnams dang sa chu dang shugs bstan me rlung rnam shes rnams 'od gsal la thim pa las/ snang ba dang mched pa sogs pa dbang po yis// thim pa'i 'gros las zhe sdang gi rtogs pa so gsum chags pa'i bzhi bcu gti mug gi bdun ste rang bzhin brgyad cu shes par bya// log ltas rgyud dkrugs rtsod ldan snyigs ma'i lnga dus// yang dag pa'i chos dpe ni nyin skar dang ru sbal spu/ bzhin du dkon no/ /log chos (6)tshong dus 'o ma'i chos spyod tshe// nyams myong dang rgyal ba'i bka' yan lag lnga pa'i lung dang them yig brgyan pa gces// lam gyi mchog tu gyur pa 'di nyid nyams su len pa rnams/ /skye ba phyi ma sogs gzhan gyi dus min 'di rab 'bring 'am bar ma dor// bde ba dang stong pa dbyer med pa'i sku gsum rang shar nas// rnam par dag pa'i mkha' spyod chen po mi slob pa'i zung 'jug nyid du 'gro// 'di nyid mi rabs bdun du chig brgyud las// spel rdo rje'i rgya yis gdab bar bya'o// chos drug rdo rje'i tshig rkang zhes bya ba rdzogs so// ye shes kyi ḍā ki ma'i zhal snga nas/ lo tsā ba glan dar ma blo gros kyis bsgyur ba'o// bdag khyung po rnal 'byor pas gser srang lnga brgya phul nas zhus te nyams su myong bar byas pa'o// phyis tho ling du lo tsā ba rin chen bzang pos kyang gtan la phab pa'o// rdo rje'i tshig rkang la/

khyung po'i mchan dkyus su shor ba/ bud+dha shrīs gzhung mchan so sor phye zhing mchan bu cung zad gnang ba la/ slar yang skad gnyis smra ba 'gyur med bde chen gyis/ blo gros kyis zhib tu dpyad cing*/ rgyas par bkod pa 'dis kyang*/ bstan pa dang sems can la phan pa rgya che bar gyur cig /'di'i tshigs bcad rnams rdo rje'i tshig rkang dngos dang*/ bar gyi lhug pa rnams khyung pos mkha' 'gro ma'i zhal shes yi ge ra bkod par snang*/ 'di la lo chen 'gyur med bde chen gyi rgyas 'grel yod do/ /sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ༈ rtsa ba chos drug gi tshig gsal bzhugs so// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs pad la// gus btud chos drug rdo rje'i tshig /ma nor mkha' 'gro'i gsung bzhin du// gzhan la phan phyir 'dir 'god bya// de'ang rdo rje 'chang gis ye shes kyi ḍā ki ma la gsungs pa'i snyan brgyud zhal gyi gdams pa 'di la drug ste/ thabs lam bde drod rang 'bar/ sgyu lus chags sdang rang grol/ rmi lam nying 'khrul rang dag /'od gsal gti mug rang (7)sangs/ 'pho ba ma bsgom sangs rgyas/ bar do rgyal ba longs sku'o// dang po thabs lam la gsum ste/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po la gsum ste/ dag byed a'i stong ra/ stong ra nad gdon sel byed/ rtags gsum stong ra'i khyad par ro// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la lnga ste/ lus gnad me'i stong ra/ gtum mo zas su za ba/ gtum mo gos su gyon pa/ gdan du 'ding ba/ srid pa'i dbang zhu ba'o// gsum pa rjes la gnyis te/ gegs rang grol/ rlung rtar zhon pa'o// gnyis pa sgyu lus la gsum ste/ dbang po rab grogs su bla ma dam pa bsten pa/ 'bring tshig gzhan gyis bar ma chod par 'khrid pa/ tha ma mal gcig tu ting nge 'dzin bskyed pa'o// dang po dbang po rab la gnyis te/ gsol 'debs lam khyer dang*/ cir snang bden med lam khyer ro// gnyis pa dbang po 'bring la'ang gnyis te/

rang lus snang stong lha sku dang*/ cir snang sgyu ma'i lam khyer ro// gsum pa dbang po tha ma la bzhi ste/ 'gro drug sgyu mar 'char byed/ nad gdon sgyu ma'i lam khyer/ 'char byed yon tan tshogs drug /zhen med sgyu ma rang shar ro// gsum pa rmi lam la drug ste/ rmi lam bzung ba dang*/ sbyong ba/ spel ba/ sprul pa/ bsgyur ba/ yul snang ngo*// dang po rmi lam bzung ba la gnyis te/ rang zin pa dang*/ 'chugs med do// dang po ni/ thig le dbang bzhi'i gnad do// gnyis pa gnad 'chugs med la dgu ste/ dus kyi gnad gsum/ lus kyi gnad gsum/ dmigs pa'i gnad gsum mo// gnyis pa sbyang ba la bzhi ste/ sems kyis lus sbyang ba/ lus kyis sems sbyang ba/ bdag med mas sbyang ba/ 'dun pas sbyang ba'o// gsum pa spel ba la gnyis te/ thug phrad du spel ba dang*/ gang 'dul du spel ba'o// dang po la bzhi ste/ 'byung ba phra ba la spel ba// (8)rags pa la spel ba/ sems can phra ba la spel ba/ rags pa la spel ba'o// gnyis pa gang 'dul la gnyis te/ 'jig rten pa'i gang 'dul/ 'das pa'i gang 'dul lo// bzhi pa sprul pa la yang de bzhin no// lnga pa bsgyur ba la bzhi ste// 'byung bzhi phra rags su bsgyur ba dang*/ sems can phra rags su bsgyur ba/ snang stong zhen bral du bsgyur ba'o// drug pa yul snang la bzhi ste/ dbang po rab dmigs byed gsal mkhyen/ 'bring gang bsam gsal mthong*/ tha ma yid lus mkha' lding*/ dman pa dmigs pa'i yul snang ngo*// de la gsum ste/ bdag med ma yul snang 'char byed/ a yul snang rang gsal/ thig le yul snang gsal byed do// bzhi pa 'od gsal la gsum ste/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi// rjes so// dang po la bzhi ste/ rtsa ba mi rtag skyo shas/ yal ga spyod la ma dam rdzas/ lo 'dab thabs lam rang dwangs/ me tog gsol 'debs 'char byed do// gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ 'od gsal bzung ba/ lam khyer bsre ba/

mthar thug gi 'od gsal lo// dang po la dgu ste/ dus kyi gnad gsum/ lus kyi gnad gsum/ dmigs pa'i gnad gsum mo// gnyis pa la gnyis te/ nyin par sku gsum lam khyer/ mtshan mo sku gsum rang shar ro// gsum pa la bzhi ste/ gsal stong bde chen du bsre ba/ nyin mtshan dbyer med du bsre ba/ lta stangs kyis mnyam rjes su bsre ba/ shes rab bde stong du bsre ba'o// bzhi pa mthar thug la lnga ste/ gsal stong rang shar gyi 'od gsal/ bde stong rang shar gyi 'od gsal/ zab zhi spros bral gyi 'od gsal/ dbyer med mthar thug gi 'od gsal/ dag pa gnyis ldan gyi 'od gsal lo// gsum pa rjes la lnga ste/ dam tshig spyi dang bye brag /gegs sel nyes skyon rang grol// bogs 'don the tshom (9)gcod byed/ khyad 'phags 'char sgo ngos 'dzin/ nyams rtogs nyin mtshan khyad par ro// lnga pa 'pho ba la bzhi ste/ chos sku de bzhin nyid kyi 'pho ba dang*/ gzugs sku zung 'jug gi 'pho ba dang*/ byin rlabs bla ma'i 'pho ba dang*/ 'chugs med mkha' spyod kyi 'pho ba'o// drug pa bar do la bzhi las/ rab bar do dang po'i 'od gsal/ 'bring rgyal ba longs sku/ tha ma sprul sku 'gag med rang shar/ spyi gnad 'chugs med lam khyer ro// lam lnga sa bcu'i rim pa rnams// mdo dang rgyud las gsungs pa ltar// rang gis nyams su myong byas nas// yid ches lung gis brgyan par bya'o// chos drug rdo rje'i tshig rkang las cung zhig gsal bar khyung po rnal 'byor pas byas pa'o/ ༈ /chos drug gi tshig gsal bzhugs so// rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs pa yi// chos drug bye brag thems yig 'di// sngon 'gro dag byed stong ra la// gsol 'debs gsum la dmigs pa gsum// thabs lam bde drod rang 'bar la// gsol 'debs gnyis la dmigs pa lnga// dbang po rab dang 'bring po la// gsol 'debs lnga la 'dun pa gsum// sgyu lus dbang po tha ma la// gsol 'debs gsum la 'dun pa gsum// rmi lam 'dzin par byed pa la// gsol 'debs gsum la 'dun pa gsum/

rmi lam sbyang ba'i chos bzhi la// gsol 'debs bzhi la dmigs pa bzhi// rmi lam spel ba'i chos drug la// gsol 'debs bzhi la 'dun pa drug /rmi lam sprul pa'i chos drug la// gsol 'debs 'dun pa de bzhin no// rmi lam bsgyur ba'i chos bzhi la// gsol 'debs bzhi la 'dun pa bzhi// sgyu lus stan thog gcig ma la// gsol 'debs brgyad la 'dun pa brgyad// yul snang dmigs pa rnam gsum la// gsol 'debs gsum la dmigs pa gsum// khyad (10)'phags 'od gsal chos bzhi la// gsol 'debs gsum la dmigs pa bzhi// 'pho ba ma bsgom sangs rgyas la// gsol 'debs gsum la dmigs pa bzhi// bar do longs spyod rdzogs sku la// gsol 'debs gsum la dmigs pa bzhi// gsol 'debs dmigs pa'i thims yig 'di// 'chugs med gnad du shes par bya// longs sku rdo rje 'chang chen gyis// ḍā ki ma la gsungs pa yi// snyan brgyud chig brgyud chos drug la// ma 'ongs dus su bsre bslad byed// de dus khrid lugs sna tshogs 'byung*// dad ldan the tshom spang ba'i phyir// 'chugs med gnad kyi thems yig bkod// gnas gsum mkha' 'gros bzod bar mdzod// chos drug rdo rje'i tshig rkang gi thems yig dang bcas pa ḍā ki ni gu mas ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin du/ bdag khyung po rnal 'byor pas yi ger bkod pa'o// rdzogs so/ ༈ gzhi lam 'bras bu'i rnam bzhag bzhugs so// gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum ni/ gzhi dbang bzhi rdzogs pa/ lam bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug /'bras bu sku gsum bde chen/ phrin las lhun grub phyogs med rang shar ro// gnad drug ni/ thabs lam rtsol ba'i gnad/ sgyu lus bde chen gyi gnad/ rmi lam 'dun pa'i gnad/ 'od gsal mos gus kyi gnad/ 'pho ba dmigs pa rtse gcig gi gnad/ bar do skyo shas kyi gnad do// gegs drug

chos drug gi ni/ thabs lam la dred rtsol ba rang sems rnam/ sgyu lus la 'thas bden zhen du/ rmi lam la 'byams gnyis su gol/ 'od gsal mos gus la brdug /'pho ba la 'phros/ bar rtog pa sna tshogs tha mal du do la 'khrul pa'o// lta sgom spyod 'bras ni// lta ba phyogs med mtha' bral/ sgom pa gsal stong 'dzin med/ dam tshig dag /spyod pa blang dor rang grol/ 'bras bu sku gsum rang shar// (11)phrin las phyogs med lhun grub bo// yang gzhi lam 'bras gsum ni/ byin rlabs dbang gi gzhi/ gtum mo lam gyi bogs 'don/ rmi lam lam gyi tshod 'dzin// 'od gsal 'bras bu 'char ba'o// gzhi lam 'bras bu'i sku gsum ni/ gzhi sku gsum rang gnas/ lam sku gsum lam khyer/ 'bras bu sku gsum mngon gyur/ phrin las lhun grub phyogs med do// ḍā ki mas seng ldeng nags kyi nam mkha' nas gsungs pa rdzogs so/ /rdo rje 'chang gis ni gu ma la gsungs/ des khyung po rnal 'byor la/ des rmog lcog pa/ de skyed sgang pa la/ des sangs rgyas ston pa la/ des shangs ston la/ des yon tan rgya mtsho la/ des byams pa dpal ba/ des blo gros gsal ba la/ des kun dga' dpa' bzang la/ des rtsa ba'i bla ma mkhas grub dkon mchog legs pa la/ des bdag la'o/ ༈ /khyad 'phags kyi gdams pa bco lnga bzhugs so// rgya gar mkha' 'gro'i ni gu ma khyad 'phags kyi gdams pa bco lnga ni/ sngon 'gro dag byed stong ra/ thabs lam bde drod rang 'bar/ sgyu lus chags sdang rang grol/ rmi lam 'khrul pa rang dag /khyad 'phags 'khor lo rnam drug /bsre 'pho shes rab rnam bzhi/ mu kha sid+dhi/ sbas pa'i rnal 'byor/ rā hu la dang*/ rdo rje gdan pa rnams kyi/ 'chugs med lam khyer rnam gsum/ dag snang lha sku rang shar/ yul snang gang bsam gsal mthong*/ 'od gsal gti mug rang sangs/ 'pho ba ma bsgoms sangs rgyas/ bar do longs spyod rdzogs sku/ kun rdzob yang log gnyis kyi

sgyu ma rmi lam/ don dam phan par yang grub pa med gnod par yang grub pa med/ gzhan don du gzugs sku rang shar du 'byung ba gang la gang 'dul du gzhan don byed pa'o ro/ rang gyi nyon mongs pa'i rgyud dri ma dang dam tshig nyams chag 'dags dkor sku glud/ sku ra pa btab pa grib la sogs pa thams cad/ 'di ni stong ra'i mtshan nyid yin/ ba stong par 'char bde drod rang (12) bzhin gsal bar 'char stong gsal 'char// 'di ni sgyu lus 'od gsal skye ba'i thabs lam mtshan nyid yin/ snang snang ba 'di sna tshogs su yang rang bzhin ma grub pa// 'di ni sgyu ma'i mtshan nyid yin// gnyis nyin par dang nub mo 'khrul la de rmi lam zin pas bden med bde bar 'char// 'di ni rmi lam mtshan nyid yin/ /nyin bar dang mtshan mo bar do gsum/ dag pa gsal bar 'char/ gsum ldan nyin bar dang mtshan mo bar do gsum gyi snang ba la brten nas ma dang*/ spangs/ 'di ni rmi lam zin pas/ 'khor lo'i mtshan nyid yin/ sgyu nyin bar ma rmi lam 'od gsal bsre// 'di ni bsre 'pho'i mtshan nyid yin// bla ma yi dam sgyu lus gsum// 'bral ba med par lam du khyer// snang stong par dbyer med bde stong dbyer med cir yang mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang ldan pa mchog /'di ni lha sku'i gnyis/ mtshan nyid yin// gang dbang po rab 'bring gis nyin par nub mo bsam zhing khams ji bzhin mthong*// 'di ni yul snang mtshan nyid yin// gsal pa dang stong pa dbyer med pa'i 'dzin med bde ba che// 'di ni 'od gsal mtshan nyid yin// 'chi sdig po che mtshams med pa byas pas kyang khar dran pas tsam gyis kyang*/ /mngon par sangs rgyas/pa// 'di ni 'pho ba'i mtshan nyid yin// snang ba dang stong pa dbyer med cing zhen bral dri ma thams cad dang bral ba bde chen sku// 'di ni longs sku'i mtshan nyid yin// sna yang log gi kun rdzob gnyis tshogs snang yang rang bzhin med// 'di ni kun rdzob mtshan nyid yin/

phan gnod spang thob ma grub pas// 'di ni don don dam pa'i bden pa de sangs rgyas kyi sku ma yin dam mtshan nyid yin/ gang 'dul gzhan don lhun gyis grub// 'di ni gzugs sku'i mtshan nyid do// khyad 'phags bco lnga pa zhes bya ba/ bdag khyung po rnal 'byor pa'i lam ma yin/ 'bras bu ma yin/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyis ma gzigs/ mi gzigs/ gzigs par mi 'gyur ro// ma rtogs mi rtogs rtogs par mi 'gyur ba'i yul yin no/ /lugs rgyas pa'o/ ༈ (13)sgyu lus drug ldan bzhugs so// na mo gu ru/ chos drug po 'di rgyas bsdus gsum ka'i thun mong ngo*// der ma zad thos bsam sgom gsum gang la yang chos drug po dang ma bral ba gcig dgos so/ /don dam ma gtogs pa'i chos bcu bzhi po de dag re re la'ang chos drug gis khyad par 'phags te/ de'ang dang por byang chub mchog tu sems ma bskyed na theg pa chen por mi 'gro bas ci byed sems can gyi don bya/ lus lhar ma bskyed na lus tha mal las mi 'gyur zhing longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku mi 'grub pas// lus yi dam du bskyed do// bla ma la gsol ba ma btab na byin rlabs mi 'byung zhing*/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags byin rlabs kyis khyad par du 'phags pa yin pas/ ji ltar 'dug kyang bla ma'i snang ba mi 'bral bar bya'o// phyag rgya chen po ma bsgoms na sangs mi rgya bas/ snang srid rang grol du rtogs par bya'o// rjes su yi rang ma bsgoms na dge ba'i lo tog phrag dog gi ser bas 'joms pas/ rang gzhan thams cad kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba la yi rang ba bsgom mo// dge ba'i rtsa ba ma bsngos na mi 'phel zhing 'dzad pas dmigs med kyi snying rje chen pos sems can gyi don du bsngo bar bya'o// sgyu lus drug ldan zhes bya ba bdag khyung po rnal 'byor pa'i lugs so/ ༈ sdong po phyag rgya chen po gwa'u ma'i rdo rje'i tshig rkang bzhugs so// rgya gar skad du/

ma hā mu dra/ bod skad du/ phyag rgya chen po// zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// bde chen lhun grub 'dus ma byas// longs sku rdo rje 'chang chen gyis// skye med rang sgra 'di skad thos// tha mal shes pa e ma ho// sngon 'gro rang bab rnam pa gsum// dngos gzhi skyon bzhi rang sar grol// mthar thug sku bzhi rang shar ro// bden par rang sa gnon gyi phyag rgya bcas/ tshigs bzhi dang rtsa dang mchu klod pa ni lus rang babs so// mchu rtsol ba dang bral zhing smra brjod (14)bral ba ni ngag rang babs so// sems mig gi lta stangs bsgom 'dod dang bral ba ni sems rang babs so// de nyid skyon bzhi dang bral bar bya ste/ chos sku dang 'du 'bral med kyang*/ nye drags pas ngo ma shes/ rang la shar kyang zab drags pas ngos ma zin/ sla drags pas yid ma ches par yengs med dang bral lo// bzang bas blor ma shong bar thag chod dang bral bas 'khor bar 'khyams so// mthar thug mnyam rjes blos byas dang bral ba'i phyir rang shar de la/ sna tshogs su gsal ba de sprul sku/ gsal 'dzin dang bral ba'i rtog pa med pa de chos sku/ gsal la rtog med de nyid bde bar shar bas longs sku/ de gsum rang bzhin dbyer mi phyed pas mthar thug bde ba chen po'i sku'o// de nyid la rtog med kyi cha de ji lta ba'i ye shes so// mi rtog la ji lta bar gsal ba'i cha de ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes so// de nyid rang bzhin gyis dbyer mi phyed pas dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med zhes pa'o// sngon 'gro'i dam tshig gsang ba'i rdo rje'o// bogs 'don snying rje gsol 'debs so// lam khyer cir snang de nyid do// mngon gyur bsgom med yengs med do// bsre ba rtog med lam khyer ro// 'od gsal lta stangs bogs 'don no// sad rjes gsal la rtog med bsre// nyin mtshan bar do'i 'od gsal ni// sa gsum dbyer med rang shar ltos// gang gis mi shes rgyud du sbas pa'i don// mthar thug tshig gcig grol ba 'di yin te// bsgom med yengs med goms shing brtan pa las// sa lam rim pa dus 'dir bgrod byed pa'i// yid la mi byed sgrib gnyis rang sar dag

/sku gsum rang shar 'bras bu lhun gyis grub// mdo rgyud kun tu bstan kyang rang bzhin gab// bla ma'i byin rlabs zhal las shes par bya// chos sku'i nam mkhar rtog pa'i sprin tshogs las// dug lnga'i glog 'gyu ye shes chen por ltos// yid la mi byed re (15)dogs kun bral ba'i// tha mal shes pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// rang shar phyag rgya chen po'i rdo rje'i tshig rdzogs so// mkha' 'gro ma de nyid mnyes par byas te/ gser srang lnga brgya phul nas zhus/ lo tsā ba glan dar ma blo gros kyi sgyur ba'o/ ༈ yal ga 'chugs med lam khyer rnam gsum gyi rdo rje'i tshig rkang bzhugs so// rgya gar skad du/ mā kar+ya tri dharma nā ma/ bod skad du/ lam khyer gyi chos gsum zhes bya ba/ dpal sku gsum bde ba chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gis bla ma mchog bsten dbang thob pas// dben par gnas shing 'jig rten blos btang nas// lam mchog 'di la rtse gcig 'bad gyur na// lo zlas lhun grub rnam gsum 'grub par 'gyur// 'di ltar snang ba sna tshogs la// brten nas bla ma yi dam dang*// sgyu ma bde stong gsal bar ni// lam khyer sku gsum rang shar 'byung*// blo ldan mi rtag skyo shas dang*// byang chub sems mchog sngon 'gro bas// rang lus yi dam spyi gtsug tu// bla ma'i rnal 'byor rdzogs byas nas// mkha' mnyam 'gro kun thabs gcig tu// snying rjes kun blang gsol ba gdab// de yis mos gus skyes pa dang*// snang ba sna tshogs thams cad kun// rim gyis bla mar blta bar bya// spyod lam rnam bzhi thams cad du// bsam pa thams cad yongs spangs nas// 'bral med bla mar lam khyer bas// cir snang bla mar 'char bar 'gyur// bla ma'i lam khyer mchog yin no// de ltar brtan par gyur pa dang*// bla ma dam pa 'di nyid kyis// bzod dka'i rgya mtsho che las bsgral// grangs med mi thob tshe 'dir thob// drin bsam 'brel mar gsol ba gdab// phyag sogs bdun po rnam dag bya// sgra rnams grags stong bla ma'i gsung*// dran rtog thugs su lam khyer bya// bla ma'i sku gsum lam khyer ro// de ltar khyad 'phags (16)lam khyer des// nyin mtshan mnyam rjes thams cad du// cir snang thams cad bla mar shes// bla ma de nyid rang gi sems// sems dang bla ma dbyer med pa'i// gsal stong bde chen rang shar 'byung*// de nas yi dam lam khyer bshad// tha mal zhen pa bzlog pa'i phyir// rang lus snang stong sgyu ma'i sku// gsal la rtog pa med par bsgom// de nas chags sdang rmongs gsum yul// phyi rol gzugs snang sna tshogs kun// rim gyis lha yi skur shes bya// de la dad cing gus ldan pas// phyag la sogs pa gong bzhin no// cir snang lha sku sgyu mar shes// lha sku de nyid rang gi sems// sems dang lha sku dbyer med pa'i// gsal stong bde chen lha sku de// sku gsum lam khyer nyid du bshad// bsam pa thams cad yongs spangs nas// 'bral med lha sku zla drug gis// skye ba 'di'am bar ma dor// rgyal ba longs sku thob par 'gyur// snang ba'i cha la bskyed rim dang*// stong pa'i cha la rdzogs rim ste// bskyed rdzogs ma yin chos 'ga' med// zung 'jug tshul 'di bstan pa'o// rang dang snang ba lhar bltas nas// sgra rnams grags tshad sngags su blta// sgra rnams grags stong rang bzhin med// sgrar gsal ye shes stong pa'i dbyings// dbyer med shes pas grol 'gyur te// gang 'dul sprul sku thob par 'gyur// dran rtog lam khyer bshad kyis nyon// dus gsum ma 'gags rang shar la// ma yengs 'dzin med sku gsum du// shes pas grol 'gyur the tshom med// yang na dug gsum lta stangs kyis// rang bzhin med 'gyur chos sku thong*// de nas sgyu ma'i lam khyer bshad// 'di ltar rmi lam sna tshogs dpes// snang ba sems su gtan la dbab// sems ni sgyu ma rmi lam ste// bzung sbyang spel sprul bsgyur ba rnams// nyin par spyod lam thams cad du// bsam pa thams cad yongs spangs nas// gnyid (17)log 'dun pas nyams blangs pas// rmi lam dus su rang shar 'byung*// sgyu 'dzin bral ba'i 'od gsal ni// mos gus lta stangs stobs las 'char// bde gsal mi rtog brjod bral ba'i// sku gsum dbyer med bde chen ni// nyin mtshan kun tu rang shar 'byung*// 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po 'byung*// mdor na dam pa'i mos gus dang*// rang lus snang stong lha skur blta// ngag gi bzlas brjod grags stong ste// sems kyi dran rtog der 'dzin bral// de ltar rtse gcig nyams blangs na// lo zlas 'bras bu mngon du 'gyur// gsang sngags mngon sum lam pa ste// kun las mchog tu gyur pa'o// khyad 'phags lam khyer gyi chos gsum zhes bya ba// ye shes kyi ḍā ki mas mdzad pa rdzogs so// lo tsā ba glan dar ma blo gros kyis bsgyur ba'o// ḍā ki ma de nyid la gser srang lnga brgya phul nas zhus te/

bdag khyung po rnal 'byor pas nyams su myong bar byas pa'o/ ༈ me tog mkha' spyod dkar mo'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra yo gi nī sā dha naṃ// bod skad du// rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ ngal bas/ don med pa'i sgo gsum gyi spyod pas bdag la gnod pa'i 'jig rten gyi bya ba kun spangs nas// sems bskyed sngon du song nas mkha' dbyings dag nas hrīḥyig las 'od dbyings 'phro 'du las// mkha' spyod ma gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan phyag g.yas rdo rje gri g.yon thod pa gug bsnams// zla ba'i mdog 'dra 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro// sku gsung thugs kyi snying po mchod byas na// sgrib tshogs dag nas mkha' dag tu 'gro// mkha' spyod dkar mo'i sgrub thabs paṇ+ḍi ta dī paṃ kā ra shrī dzñā nas mar me mdzad ye shes dpal/ mdzad pa rdzogs so/ ༈ mkha' spyod dmar mo'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// stong nyid snying rje dbyer med sku// rnal 'byor ma la gus btud (18)nas// mkha' spyod gnas su khrid byed pa'i// yan lag lnga bsdu'i sbyor ba bshad// de la rje btsun mkha' spyod ma bsgom par 'dod pas/ byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems bskyed do// de nas ma'i mngal stong pa gcig gi nang du hūm̐ sngon po'am/ thig le sngon po gcig bsam/ de ltem gyis zhu ba las/ bdag nyid dgyes mdzad dam/ bde mchog 'od zer lnga 'phro ba gcig tu bskyed do// de nas rang gi mdun du chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ bde bar rgyu zhing bde bar 'char ba 'od kyi rang bzhin can gcig bsgom/ de'i nang du mi ro dkar po mgo bo g.yon du bstan pa'i steng du/ rje btsun mkha' spyod ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ sku mdog dmar mo rus pa'i rgyan lngas spras pa/ gcer bu skra grol ba/ thod skam lngas dbu brgyan pa/

spyan gsum gyen la hrig hrig gzigs pa/ mche ba cung zad gtsigs shing bzhad pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje gri gug 'phyar stabs su bsnams shing*/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis bkang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa// rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ ga mchan khung du bcug pa/ mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gzhon nu dar la bab pa/ sku sha rgyas shing nu ma 'bur ba/ zhabs g.yas brkyang zhing g.yon bskum pas ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na yed yed// 'phar la khad pa gcig bsam mo// de nas rang dgyes mdzad dam/ bde mchog tu gnas pa'i lte bar thig le dkar po a yi ngo bor gnas pa gcig bsam/ 'od zer lnga 'phros pas bdag gzhan gyi mngal gyi dri ma sbyangs par bsam mo// de nas a de lte ba nas mas yar dkar yer yer byung ste/ sna bug g.yon nas phyir thon te/ rje btsun ma'i thugs kar thim pas rang lus stong par bsgom/ rje btsun ma de yang tog gis yar te/ mkha' spyod la mda' 'phangs pa bzhin du rgyangs kyis song bar bsam/ de 'dra ba thebs bdun bsgom par bya'o// de'i rjes (19)la rje btsun mkha' spyod nas mar byon te/ rang gi spyi bor zhabs gnyis bsgrad nas bzhugs par bsgom/ de'i pad+ma nas byang chub kyi sems dmar ba la dkar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ bde khri li li babs te/ spyi bo'i tshangs bug nas mar song bas/ lus thams cad byang sems kyis mer te khengs pa dang*/ dbang bzhi thob nas zag pa med pa'i bde ba chil chil rgyas par bsams la/ de la sems dar cig bzhag go /de nas rje btsun ma spyi bo nas mar thim nas lte bar slebs pa dang*// bde ba la stong pas khyab pas/ bde stong gnyis su med pa'i nyams sing skyes par bsam/ de'i ngang la sems ma bcos par bzhag go /dge ba byang chub tu bsngo'o// de ltar yun ring du bsgom pa gcig gis// 'chi rtags rnams byung nas 'chi bar ngo shes pa'i dus su/ lus dang longs spyod la chags pa med pa'i sbyin pa btang*/

'du 'dzi'i g.yeng ba phyir bskyed la/ rang gi bla ma dang dkon mchog la gsol ba gdab/ smon lam rnam par dag pa yang dag gdab/ de nas sngar bzhin du bsgom ste/ rang gi lte ba'i thig le de rje btsun mar bsams la/ rje btsun ma rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo de// mas yar lte ba na rgyangs kyis song ste/ spyi bo'i tshangs bug nas yar don te/ mkha' spyod du gshegs pa dang*/ skye med phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du bzhag go /des mkha' spyod du 'gro bar 'gyur ro// skye gnas lnga gcig car du dag pa thig le'i 'pho ba zhes bya ba bla ma rā hu la'i gdams pa rdzogs so/ ༈ /'bras bu lus 'chi med kyi rtsa ba bzhugs so// rgya gar skad du/ a mā ra sid+dhi mū la/ bod skad du/ 'chi med grub pa zhes bya ba'i rtsa ba/ dbu bcad spyan gsum dmar ba'i mdog 'dzin zhing*// 'chi ba'i 'jigs sel rnal 'byor rnal 'byor ma'i// phyag rgya de bzhin bir+wa brgyud par 'dzin// drag po'i khams kyi (20)stobs ldan de la 'dud// phyag 'tshal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid can// khams gsum pa yi ngo bo nyid// bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od// phyag rgya chen po rnam bshad pa// rgyud rnams kun tu sbas pa'i don// ming ni gang gis thos pa yis// lha rnams kun gyis mchod par 'gyur// skye ba bye ba stong dag tu// legs byas rgya chen rnams byas pas// de thob 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las// pha rol du ni rnal 'byor 'gro// chos dang longs spyod sprul pa dang*// bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo ni// mi skrag pa dang rgyun chad med// nub kyi rtsa ru bskul byas pas// sa yi dkyil 'khor bsgrub par bya// gshang lam gyen du drangs pa yi// me yi dkyil 'khor bsgrub par bya/ hūm̐ gis rlung gi dkyil 'khor ni/ gyen du drangs pas 'dul bar byed// rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor dbye ba yis// ma ni su ra ki ru bya// des ni chu yi dkyil 'khor thul// rtag pa dang ni mi rtag dang*// 'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das// skrag pa med cing thul bar 'gyur// rgyun chad med pa'i dkyil 'khor gyis// rigs drug 'gro ba'i 'khor la btul// thog mar g.yas kyi mig tu na// rnal 'byor ma ni chen mo ste// dbugs rnams thams cad sdud par byed// g.yon gyi ngos na la lā na// de yang de bzhin bsdu ba yi// dbu ma'i rtsa ru btsud byas nas// zhen pa dang ni gdung ba spong*// rkyen rnams gang gis mi shes shing*// thig le nā da rnam par spangs// 'byung po rnams kyis bkur sti byed// de ni lus kyi dbye ba'o// g.yon pa'i rting pas bshang lam dgag

/rtsa bas dam du rnam par mnan// rtsa sgo gnyis ni dam du bsdam// g.yas pa cung zad brkyang bar bya// stan la legs par 'dug byas te// snying ga lkog mas mnan par bya// sgo gsum dgag pa'i sbyor ba'o// rlung rnams gcig tu bsdu bar bya// rkang (21)pa bzhi par sems ni bsdu// rlung gis gdams pa brtsam par bya// nyi zla gnyis kyis bcag par bya// de ltar byas pas rlung ni dgag /bshang lam 'khor lo gyen du bzlog /thig le sgra gcan gyen du blang*// rtsa rnams thams cad rab tu g.yo// mchog gi rtsa ni gyen du'o// lus ngag yid gsum sbyor ba yis// sku gsung thugs ni sgrub pa yin// goms pa brtan par gyur pa yi// rang gi me ni gsal ba'o// phyag rgya 'di yis thams cad du// rnal 'byor pa ni nges par 'gro// 'di ni kha sbyor sbyor ba ste// rtsa ba'i sdom par 'dod pa'o// 'di ni rlung gi sbyor ba yin// mkhas pa rnams kyis 'di bsgrub bo// phyag rgya gnyis su shes bya ste// ji bzhin sdom pa'i cho gas shes// dzño ni lha mo'i phyag rgya yin// ling ga'i phyag rgya lha yin no// pho dang mo yi sbyor ba las// phyi rol du ni skye bar 'gyur// ji bzhin sbyor ba de gnyis kyis// skye ba nang du gsad par bya// rtsa ni yon tan gzugs can te// skyes pa med na 'bras bu med// phyag rgya che dang bsdams pa med// dbye ba med na 'bras bu med// rlung ni 'khor lo gcig tu bsdu// ji srid bsdams pa bzhin du bya// rnal 'byor pa yis gzhig par bya// rang gi rlung sems gzhig par bya// rlung gi stobs dang ldan byas la// dbu ma'i sgo ru gzhug par bya// sbyor ba'i rim pas gzhig par bya// 'khor lo bzhi po rlung gis dbug /lag pa'i liṅga bsdam bya ste// rkang pa gnyis ni steng du bstan// rtse mo gnyis ni sa la gzug /brtan par brla la brdab par bya// ji srid thub tshad sprugs par bya// rlung gis rlung ni bshig par byed// rlung gis rlung la bskrun par bya// rlung gis rlung ni gsad par bya// rlung gis yongs la khyab pa yi// rlung gis dngos grub thams cad sbyin// rlung gis 'chi ba med par 'gyur// des na bdud rtsi grub pa zhes// (22)bir+wa pa yis gsungs pa yin// legs bsdam lus kyi las yin te// lhun po yis ni bar dag tu// rdo rje'i rlung rtse bya ba yis// dbug pa'i sbyor ba 'di yis ni// tshangs pa'i mdud pa bshig par bya// lhun po'i steng du lha rnams 'gro// lhun po dag ni g.yo 'gyur te// des ni thams cad brgyal bar 'gyur// tshangs pa la sogs lha rnams gsang*// dang po yi ni sbyor ba yis// tshangs pa'i mdud pa bshig par bya// de bshig nas ni biṣ+ṇu bshig

/de nas dbang phyug mdud pa bshig /de nas gti mug la sogs spangs// tshangs pa'i sgo ni sbas pa la// rlung gi sgo ni rnam par dbye// gdams pa che dang 'bigs pa che// phyag rgya che ni gsum pa yin// 'di ni gsang ba gsum yin no// de dag gis ni sbyor grub grags// de nyid gsum ni gang rigs pas// de ni 'jig rten gsum rig go /gang gis 'di la goms byas na// thams cad kyi ni mnga' bdag 'gyur// bsrung ba lha yi lha rnams dang*// mi yi bdag po'i bdag por 'gyur// dbang bskur kun la dag pa yin// thams cad ma lus lhag par 'gyur// des na lha rnams kun gyis 'bad// phyag rgya che la goms par bya// phyag rgya 'di yis thams cad 'byung*// grub pa chen po gang yin pa// rnam gnyis de ni dam pa dang*// 'chi ba las ni grol ba dang*// lus sems la ni phan pa 'byung*// sems la gnas pa tsam gyis kyang*// mngal du skye bar mi 'gyur ro// phyag rgya'i dam tshig ji lta bu// las kyi phyag rgya dag la ni// 'gro ba rnams ni de las skyes// las ni rigs drug dag kyang yin// chos ni chos kyi phyag rgya yin// sems kyis de blang nyams su sbyar// bla ma'i zhabs la btud byas te// bla ma la gus dga' bar bzung*// 'di ni dam tshig phyag rgya'o// phyag rgya chen pos rtsa dgu bsdam// rkang pa lag pas bsdam bya ste// rtsa rnams thams cad (23)'then par bya// srog rlung lan gsum dbyung bya ste// langs pas rtsa rnams gyen du phyogs// nad rnams thams cad bcom nas ni// phyag rgya chen po'i don yang rdzogs// ji ltar bar snang nam mkha' la// sprin tshogs 'bar ba 'khrigs pa ste// rlung gis shugs kyis gtor ba ltar// de bzhin lus 'di dag kyang ni// nad kyis yongs su bgos gyur kyang*// thabs kyi rlung gis gzhom par bya// dka' bas 'byung ba lnga dag kyang*// las kyi bya bas mnye bya zhing*// dbang po ngal zhing dub pa'i tshe// rtse gcig sems kyi ngang du bzhag

/bsdam pa chen pos gnas par bya// stobs kyi 'khor lo 'di yis ni// steng du lha yi 'jig rten skrag /rkang pa 'og tu brkyang pa yis// klu rnams kun kyang skrag par byed// lag pa brkyang bskum 'di yis ni// phyogs bzhi dag kyang g.yo bar byed// 'di ni dzha hi ta'i skar ma'o// dang po mi ni yi ge yin// sbyor ba ldan par bshad par bya// dad dang ldan pa'i sbyor ba yis// rnal 'byor pas ni nges par ni// phyag rgya chen po 'grub pa yin// sdom pa chen po bshad par bya// rlung gis lus ni 'jigs par 'gyur// sdom pa gnyis su shes bya ste// ji bzhin thig le gnas pa dang*// dzha ki bhan+dha'i lha mo yin// mgrin pa bsdam pa lha yin no// dgang ba can dang bum pa can// phyag rgya bzung bar rnam par bya// skad cig nyid la bsdam par bya// lha dang lha min kun la gsang*// bshang lam bsdam pa dang ldan pas// rlung ni rnam par bskum pa dang*// gyen du blang bar byas pa yin// mnyam pa'i rlung dang bsre bar bya// rnal 'byor bsdam par byas pa yin// dbu ma'i sgo ru gtad par bya// lam gsum rnam par 'gog par bya// rlung ni nang du bzung bar bya// srog gi rlung yang brlan par bya// de ltar byas pas 'og tu 'bam// gyen du bskyod par bya ba yin// steng 'og rlung gi sbyor ba'o// (24)'di ltar mi yi lus la ni// grub pa'i lam ni rab gsal ba// nyams myong skye zhing lus rgyas 'gyur// rgus par yang ni mi 'gyur ro// rtsa rnams rgyun ni 'bab pa dang*// rtag par 'og tu 'gro ba yin// bsdam pa chen po 'di yis ni// rnam par bzlog par 'gyur ba yin// gshis ni thur du 'gro ba yin// lus kyi phyi rol 'gro ba dang*// yung ba'i nang du chu 'bab ste// de ni bsdams pas ldog par 'gyur// ji srid phyi rol 'gro ba dang*// bsdams pas ldag par 'gyur ba yin// de bzhin nang gi lus la yang*// rnal 'byor rtag tu shes par bya// lus kyi rtsa ni ma lus kyang*// 'dis ni bsdam par rab tu grags// gdams pa 'di yi mthu yis ni// lha rnams kun gyis gsal bar 'gyur// 'di ltar gdams pa bzhi yis ni// lam gsum rnam par bkag pa'o// lam bzhi po ni gsal ba yin// grub pa lha yi lam du 'gro// skye dang 'chi ba'i lam gnyis po// 'og gi lam du bshad pa yin// bsod nams dang ni sdig rgyu yin// de phyir skyon gnyis rnam par spangs// rlung gi de nyid bum pa can// de ni rab tu mnyam par bya// steng gi lam du rnam byas la// rlung dang lhan cig sbyor ba yi// gdams pas chu rgyun 'gag pa ltar// 'gro ba thams cad rnam par 'gog

/des na de yi bka' drin gyis// dzho ni gdams pa zhes grags so// grub pa'i lam dang yang dag ldan// mi ni 'gyur te gzhan du min// phyag rgya 'di ni shes pa yis// dregs pa yod kyang don dang ldan// des ni thams cad shes pa yin// 'chi med grub pa zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po dpal bir+wa pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// rgya gar gyi rnal 'byor pa chen po dpal dur khrod pa'i zhal snga nas dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba mar pa lo tsā bas te to'i dur khrod du bsgyur ba'o/ ༈ sems 'chi med kyi rtsa ba bzhugs so// rgya gar skad du// shrī a mā ra ma hā dzñā na nā ma// (25)bod skad du/ dpal 'chi med ye shes chen po zhes bya ba/ dpal 'chi med ye shes chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal ba longs sku rdo rje 'chang chen gyis// 'chi med ye shes rang sgra 'di skad thos// gang zhig dad ldan dbang po dam tshig can// bla ma mchog bsten 'di don rtogs par gyis// gang gis tshe 'di blos btang nas// rtse gcig zhag bdun lo zla yis// ji ltar nyon mongs lus dag la// ye shes lus ni rang dgar 'byung*// tshad med sems bskyed sngon 'gro bas// cho ga gsum mam skad cig gis// rang lus yi dam yab yum gyi// spyi gtsug sa bon

hūm̐ dang bam̐ gyi 'od zer gyis// lus kyi phyi nang thams cad kun// dag cing stong gsal nyid sbyangs pas// snang stong 'ja' tshon 'od kyi sku// rang bzhin med bzhin sku mdog dang*// zhal phyag rgyan dang me phung bcas// gsal la rtog pa med pa yi// zag med bde stong chen por ltos// rang lus snang stong lha sku sems// sems ni snang stong lha yi sku// sems dang lha sku dbyer med de// rmi lam yul du chu zla ltar// rang bzhin zung 'jug chen po yi// ngo bo brjod bral blo 'das te// de ni dus gsum sangs rgyas kyis// ma gzigs mi gzigs gzigs mi 'gyur// de la na rgyu 'chi rgyu dang*// 'khor ba ma grub myang 'das ma grub cing*// 'pho bya 'pho byed bral bas na// de phyir 'chi med rang grol lo// de ltar ma rtogs rnal 'byor bas// bskal par bsgrub kyang don med 'gyur// log pa'i lam zhugs kho nar zad// gang gis mtshams med lnga rdzogs kyang*// 'chi kha'i do tshe'am dus gzhan du// 'chi med rdo rje'i tshig rkang bzhi/ /ye shes rgya mtsho'i rgyud las/ /skad cig yud tsam gcig pa'am// dran thos reg par gyur bas kyang*// gnad gcod sdug bsngal rang dag nas// bar dor longs skur mngon sangs rgya// sgrib pa chung (26)rnams smos ci dgos// 'di ni 'chugs med gnad yin no// gal te lus sems rkyen dbang gis// 'chi khar dran par ma gyur kyang*// dper na sgyogs kyi 'khrul 'khor bzhin// sngar gyi gnad kyis bar ma dor// rgyal ba longs sku rang shar 'byung*// mtshams sbyor ngan pas rgyud dkrugs kyang*// gsal dwangs rdzing bur rdo rgyab bzhin// sngar gyi gnad kyis bar ma dor/ longs sku bde chen rang shar 'byung*// brtan par ma gyur long med kyang*// bco lnga'i nyi rgas zla shar bzhin// 'chi'am 'chi khar dran thos kyis// bar dor longs sku the tshom med// rang sems skye med chos sku las// 'gags med gzugs skur rang shar gyis// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma stongs bar// gang 'dul gzhan don lhun gyis grub// ngo bo rnam pa phrin las rnams// zung 'jug chen por rtogs par gyis// 'chi ba zhes bya rnam rtog ste// 'chi rgyu med pa dbang po rab// de don skad cig rtogs 'gyur pas// dag pa bde stong mkha' spyod 'gro// dus gsum rgyal bas 'di rtogs pas// bdud btul sangs rgyas 'khor lo bskor// de phyir rgyal ba'i thugs bcud 'di// mdo rgyud du mar bstan gyur kyang*// dam pa'i drin gyis ma gtogs pa// thabs gzhan gang gis rnyed mi 'gyur// de phyir bla ma mchog brten nas// gus shing mnyes pa gnad yin no// snyigs ma log ltas rgyud dkrugs tshe// yid ches lung gis brgyan par bya// 'chi med ye shes chen po 'di// chig brgyud rdo rje'i rgya yis btab// mi rabs bdun nas gsum la'o// rang sems 'chi med rang grol rdzogs so// ye shes kyi ḍā ki mas seng ldeng gi nags gseb tu gsungs nas/

lo tsā ba glan dar ma blo gros kyis bsgyur ba'o// lo tsā ba de nyid dang*/ rin chen bzang pos kyang gtan la phab pa'o// ḍā ki ma de nyid la bdag khyung po rnal (27)'byor pas gser srang lnga brgya phul nas zhus te nyams su myong bar byas pa'o// 'chi med tshig rkang rdzogs so// dge'o/// /dge'o/// /dge'o/// // /(28)
